notes.title: 🎮 UPDATE 1: NEW WAYS TO PLAY - OUT NOW! 🎮
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/3781fd376de5d63e9c67af4cff8c748944a5f51e.png"][/img][/p][p]🌱 [b]Dear Sproutlings[/b] 🌱  [/p][p]It's been a hot minute since we announced this update - but now its finally ready to go.[/p][p]Heres what we added to Space Sprouts today:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Controller Support![/b] [/h3][p]You can now enjoy Space Sprouts with your favourite controller. This was a bit harder than you might think ([i]Unity UI cough[/i]). We did quite a lot of testing to make throwing things around as satisfying as possible. And we're really happy that now you can just sit back and mess around with all the weird things in our game with a controller - it just [i]feels nice[/i]. And of course you can always re-map everything in the settings menu![/p][p][/p][h3][b]💨Steam Deck Optimization![/b] [/h3][p]You can now play Space Sprouts on the go with your Steam Deck. It took us quite a bit of time (and help from our most favourite tech wizard) to optimize it for the Deck. We're really happy with its performance now and seeing our game running on that pretty OLED screen really made us smile. If you've got a Steam Deck give it a spin. [/p][p]There are of course limits to what the little machine can handle in terms of item duplication and black hole shenanigans - so experiment at your own risk. If you run into any problems let us know on our Discord. And if it runs fine, let Steam know - so we might get that prestigious "Verified" badge some time in the future.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese Localization![/b] [/h3][p]With the help of two lovely people from the Space Sprouts community the game now has an official Simplified Chinese translation. As a tiny team we are so grateful to see people actively helping us to make Space Sprouts accessible to more players around the world. Thanks so much TE-Eh & Butterfly, you're rad![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧠 3 New Memories![/b] [/h3][p]We also added three new memories to discover on your big ol' space ship. Might they be connected to this update? Take another flight, poke around and find it out yourself! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/eacc247110f3e468d6dc3617daa1aac731cd0293.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Thats it for the first update.[/b] The second update SECRETS & MEMORIES is in the works and is coming as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers & thanks for playing![/p][p]- [i]The Schleuder Gäng[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p]⭐💚 And don’t forget[b] [/b]to [b]leave a review for[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/"] Space Sprouts[/url][/b], it helps us more than you might think 💚⭐  [/p][p][/p][h3]Find us online:[/h3][p]🌱[url="https://bsky.app/profile/schleudergames.bsky.social"]Space Sprouts on BlueSky[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://www.instagram.com/schleudergames/"]Space Sprouts on Instagram[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://www.tiktok.com/@schleudergames"]Space Sprouts on Tiktok[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd"]Join us on Discord[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://schleuder.games/"]Our official website[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Love, Peace & Video Games[/b] 🌈  [/p]

notes.title: ⭐ THE FUTURE OF SPACE SPROUTS ⭐
notes.notes: [p]🌱 [b]Dear Sproutlings[/b] 🌱  [/p][p]Its been almost [b]three months since we released Space Sprouts[/b]. It was quite a busy time for us - fixing bugs, going to conventions, enjoying the numerous streams, etc. But after a while it all slowed down again. So we finally took some time to enjoy life again. [/p][p][/p][p]And after we all had a good long nap, we sat down and made a list of [b]things we still wanted to add to the game[/b]. You know, these small (and sometimes not so small) ideas, that we thought would be really fun or cool or weird, but where ultimately cut during development. [/p][p][/p][p]And then we made a plan on how to actually do this. So naturally we came up with this very official Roadmap™️ graphic: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/9073c8d9ae993ca6caf97277a09f3bc014ce4791.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The best part: UPDATE #1 - "NEW WAYS TO PLAY"[/b] [b][strike]will go live next week[/strike][/b][strike] already, just in time for the Steam Summer Sale[/strike] as soon as its ready (sorry for the delay ;_;). While we won't spoil too much just yet, in this update we will add some things that quite a few people asked about. We hope you will have fun with the things we got cookin' and revisit Oda and their big ol' space ship once more. [/p][p][/p][p]For our own sanity we wont set any fixed dates for Update 2+3 yet. But [b]we are actively working on further updates[/b] and will release them as soon as they are ready to go. Which will be sooner rather than later. We can't wait to tell you more about them - its going to be wild 👀[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lastly thanks so much to all of you for playing our weird little space game, it truly means the world to us ✨[/b][/p][p]See you soon!  [/p][p]- [i]The Schleuder Gäng[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Edit:[/b] We sadly had to postpone the first Update since we underestimated the effort and some processes that are out of our hands. Being only two people developing this game we are trying our best to get this out as soon as possible. Thank you for the patience.[/p][p][/p][p]⭐💚 And don’t forget[b] [/b]to [b]leave a review for[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/"] Space Sprouts[/url][/b], it helps us more than you might think 💚⭐  [/p][p][/p][h3]Find us online:[/h3][p]🌱[url="https://bsky.app/profile/schleudergames.bsky.social"]Space Sprouts on BlueSky[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://www.instagram.com/schleudergames/"]Space Sprouts on Instagram[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://www.tiktok.com/@schleudergames"]Space Sprouts on Tiktok[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd"]Join us on Discord[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://schleuder.games/"]Our official website[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Love, Peace & Video Games[/b] 🌈  [/p]

notes.title: ⭐ THANK YOU! ⭐
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/d1f294f1ba288d197415ddc25a591e4e9a51a66c.png[/img]
[i]Thank you all so much for the great feedback and support... It means the world to us! ♥[/i]

[h3][b]💫 A Journey Into The Unknown 💫[/b][/h3]

[b]Dear Sproutlings[/b] 🌱,

On a sunny day about three years ago, we were sitting on a park bench in Berlin, spitballing random game ideas that we wanted to explore. Ideas that stuck with us and came back to us from time to time. One of them was fairly simple: [b]What about a game where you are alone in space and you start talking to your plant?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/8d049030c0f0513b93b4233f34b57876dc89297e.gif[/img]

This simple concept changed and transformed over time—as most game ideas do. Over time it grew into different forms; each of them could've been a proper game. From a narrative-driven comic game to a sci-fi survival sandbox (eat those hamburgers before you sleep, Oda!) and [b]finally to the unique blend of genres that we have today[/b].

But there were other parts of the concept that remained steadfast: A short journey through space. [b]A mysterious ship that you explore on your own terms. Systemic gameplay. Time as a key factor[/b] of your journey. The main character is Oda, a young person with a very firm turquoise bun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/883648268ba4459cedd8113ebd2096d6398250d3.png[/img][i]An early prototype of Space Sprouts[/i]

[h3][b]💫 A new perspective 💫[/b][/h3]

Fast forward to today: After two years of development and the help of so many people, [b]our first game Space Sprouts launched two days ago[/b].

Space Sprouts is the first commercial game we developed from start to finish. These last few days we could slowly let go of the game development tunnel vision and just watch. Watch people having genuine fun. See players [b]experimenting with the games systems, wondering, exploring[/b]. Uncover all the weird little details we put in the game. It felt strange yet wholesome, seeing our little game existing out there, in the world, all on its own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/f1a518085e1bb64c0cddf213e852bcb7af5b910f.png[/img]

Over the past two years Space Sprouts grew into a game that we love and deeply care about. A game that combines the vision and sensibilities of everyone who worked on it.[b] A game with an expansive solar punk spaceship, with 100 achievements and a unique world to explore.[/b] And also with a black hole that you can throw stuff into. If you like.

We hope you have fun while you explore it for yourself. And if you do, [b]make sure to leave us a review[/b]. We'd really appreciate that.

[i]- Torben & the Schleuder Gäng[/i]

[b]Love, Peace & Video Games forever[/b]! 💖

notes.title: ⭐ THE COUNTDOWN IS ON! ⭐
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/90e5c839a094c7a45af1f68f7d144646f8066db2.png[/img]

[h3][b]🚀 THE FINAL STRETCH – IT’S ALL IN THE DETAILS![/b][/h3]

[b]Dear Sproutlings[/b] 🌱,

We’re in the [b]final stretch [/b]of making [i]Space Sprouts[/i], and right now, it’s all about the [b]little details[/b]! From the [b]most remote areas[/b] to[b] dark hidden nooks[/b], we’ve been adding the finishing touches to make the game feel truly complete.

And, of course, we’ve tackled some of life’s [b]most important questions[/b], such as:
 💩 [i]What happens to poop in outer space? [/i](Yes, really.) You'll have to play the game to find out for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/0558a6972981ba2c3d955e5dda85a2db316b7210.png[/img]

Alongside[b] fixing countless bugs [/b](while still leaving a few fun ways to break the game 🤭), we’ve added something we think you’ll love:

[h3][b]📒 A Notebook for Your Adventures![/b][/h3]

Thanks to your feedback, you will get an [b]in-game notebook[/b] with which you'll be able to:
[list]

[*] Take notes on[b] important details [/b]📝
[*] Track key discoveries [b]across multiple runs[/b] 🔍
[*] Keep a [b]personal log [/b]of your spacefaring journey 🚀
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/d3e3d384dc45b8af504856eed70af68ce50c6c31.png[/img]

You'll also be able to export your scribbles and share them with your friends! By the way, we will hold a new community challenge related to the notebook during the launch. We will announce all the details here on Steam and on [url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd]our Discord[/url] next week!

[h3][b]🎨 Final Touches & Even Deeper Secrets[/b][/h3]

Many sections are getting their final touch-up:
[list]

[*] [b]Objects & items[/b] have been polished and refined ✨
[*] Your [b]destination planet[/b] has been completely [b]redrawn[/b] to be more breathtaking than ever 🌍
[*] We’ve added [b]very hard memories[/b] for those of you who love to [b]dig deep and uncover every secret[/b]🧠
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/562a51504126c47dae28d1400ce76bd5d203e174.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🌟 The Final Push[/b][/h3]
While we’re making a lot of [b]promotional efforts[/b], we’re also making sure the [b]core experience[/b] is as polished and rewarding as possible.

We’re almost there, and we can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been working on! As always—[b]Love, Peace & Video Games forever[/b]! 💖

⭐💚 Don’t forget to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]WISHLIST Space Sprouts[/url][/b]! And if you can, it would help us immensely if you could buy it and [b]leave a review as early as possible[/b], as it helps us to get more visibility from Steam! 💚⭐

We'll be back next week with all the details about the release, including details about [b]the pricing[/b], [b]the launch discount[/b] and[b] languages available [/b]at launch. Until then!

notes.title: ⭐ STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO! FINAL TOUCHES BEFORE RELEASE!⭐
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/b803455512cd32146b0bd725bc9a4c4461f5f77b.png[/img]

[h3][b]🚀 Final Touches Before Launch![/b][/h3]

Dear Sproutlings 🌱,

We’re in the final stretch of development, and Space Sprouts is getting its last big improvements before release! Every room in the ship is receiving a visual makeover and recoloring, bringing a fresh coat of paint to the entire world. But that’s not all—we’ve also added [b]new memories, edge cases, and hidden Easter eggs[/b] for players to discover. Keep your eyes open! 👀

[h3][b]🖥️ Revamped UI: Result Screens, Memories & Map[/b][/h3]
We’ve made major improvements or fully rebuilt some of the game’s UI to enhance the experience:
- [b]New animated result screens[/b] 🎉 – After each run, you’ll now see what you discovered in even cooler ways.
-[b] Improved Memory UI & popups[/b] 🧠 – Track new discoveries, recalled memories, and reconstructed ones more easily.
- [b]New Map UI [/b]🗺️ – Get a clearer overview of where you’ve been and where to go next.
- [b]Quality-of-life improvements [/b]✨ – Features like pinning memories allow for better run planning and tracking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/f3294ce1445754529801f2ce289fa64fa1aa80b9.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🎨 Improved Room Colors[/b][/h3]
We updated all room colors to give each room its own distinct identity. Both for better orientation and because it just looks nicer. We had this on our to-do-list since forever and now we finally had the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/776edc6c4c99d454b4e46c0eb987af5ce1c7b026.png[/img]

[h3][b]✨ All New Key Art[/b][/h3]
The more defined Space Sprouts got over time the more we needed new key art that represents the game better. While the old key art is dear to our hearts (it accompanied us on many conventions last year) we are so happy to reveal this all new detailed illustration of Oda being maybe a bit too curious. We hope you like it as much as we do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/158ad0399ca29c5705d0fbd744eff620ce0a90b7.png[/img]

[h3][b]🎮 Steam Next Fest – Big Demo Update![/b][/h3]
To celebrate these updates, we’ve wrapped the current state of the game into a big demo update for Steam Next Fest! This version showcases some of the new content, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]so don’t miss it[/url]!

[h3][b]💥Most chaotic screenshot contest![/b][/h3]
To celebrate our participation at Steam Next Fest with a new demo, we're running a contest on our [url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd]Discord[/url]! Send us your most chaotic screenshot of the new Space Sprouts demo during the duration of the festival for a chance to win [b]a pack of stickers, a hand-drawn illustration[/b] and [b]a copy of the game[/b]!

[h3][b]🌍 Localization – Want to Help?[/b][/h3]
Last but not least, we’re currently translating the game into multiple languages! If you’re a native speaker in a language other than English and want to contribute, let us know—we’d love your support! Leave a comment below or join us on [url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd]Discord[/url]!

[h3][b]Love, Peace & Video Games forever! 💖[/b][/h3]
⭐ Space Sprouts is launching on March 31st! Don’t forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]wishlist[/url] Space Sprouts on Steam to get notified at launch!! ⭐

notes.title: ⭐ DECEMBER NEWS ⭐
notes.notes:
[b][h1]A LOOK BACK AT 2024 🌟🎄[/h1][/b]

Dear Sproutlings 🌱,

as the holidays approach and 2024 draws to a close, what better time to reflect on the incredible journey this year has been?

[h3][b]🚀 From a Single Room to a Growing Universe[/b][/h3]

2024 truly was the year for Space Sprouts! The game evolved from a small placeholder tech demo with just one room into a huge experience with almost 20 unique rooms filled with real gameplay and personality.

We dug into our archives and found this screenshot from last December: the cockpit area – the only existing room at the time. While much has transformed since then (and Oda no longer looks like a LEGO minifigure), there’s one object in this screenshot that hasn’t changed a bit. Can you spot it? 👀

[i]Oda floating in the very first 2023 cockpit[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/2386d6db330099b1f97e2c48bdd6b7bc6e5fe7d4.png[/img] 

[i]Oda floating in the December 2024 cockpit[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/7ba52670286d9ab536c8f10b2640b5aac039354f.png[/img]

[h3][b]🛠️ The Journey Toward Release[/b][/h3]

As we approach the release early next year, we’re hard at work:
[list]
[*] Making the game prettier 🎨
[*] Adding the final areas 🚪
[*] Polishing existing ones to become their best selves ✨
[/list]
This year flew by in a blast! It feels like just yesterday we launched our first free demo for you all to play. Alongside the growing main game, the demo has been updated steadily – and if you haven’t checked it out yet, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]it’s still available to play[/url]!

[h3][b]💚 A Big Thank You[/b][/h3]

We want to thank:
[list]
[*] Our weekly playtesters 🕹️
[*] Everyone who played the demo, wishlisted, reported bugs, shared feedback, or sent kind words 💬
[*] All the amazing people we met at the events we attended this year 🎉[/list]
Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait to share more details about what’s next – including the actual release date, very soon.

notes.notes:
[h2]Huge announcement in 1 week![/h2]
Dear Sproutlings 🌱,
this month has us on the edge of our seats! We are finalists for the GWB Game Awards, yay! The award ceremony will take place next week on Friday, the 22nd of November and we are one of the amazing finalists in the overseas category! We have an exciting announcement to make during the event, so keep an eye on our socials and Steam newsletter!

[h2]What have we been working on?[/h2]
The last months we've continued to work on expanding the spaceship and adding new rooms. Something else we have achieved is the complete overhaul of the tutorial, so let's look at some of the changes we made:

[h4]New tutorial area[/h4] 
We have done a complete overhaul of the tutorial and added a new area for you to explore before taking off into space. Some cool details:
[list]
[*] You will be able to crack open a cold one, rummage through suitcases with peculiar items or get a massage of interstellar quality. 💼
[*] You can also take some time to say Goodbye to Oda's family now! ❤️
[*] Handpainted murals on the walls tell the story of what every young person goes through when they reach adulthood. 🎨
[*] A huge panorama in the background gives you one last, breathtaking view of the home planet before you blast off. 🌅
[/list]
[h4]We've also added some...[/h4]
... outfit and hairstyle changes, different spaceship layout, added fire, new color design and loads of opportunities to experiment!

notes.title: ⭐ LAUNCHING A NEW DEMO ⭐
notes.notes:
[h2]Launching a new demo![/h2]
Along with the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration starting today, we have now launched a brand [b]NEW DEMO[/b] version for Space Sprouts! Keep in mind that it is only available in English right now, but we plan on localizing the final game version!

[h3]WISHLIST our game![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/

[h3]Added Features:[/h3]
⭐[b]3 NEW AREAS![/b]
💪 Space Gym: Get in shape to reveal hidden secrets and shortcuts!
🚀 Gangway: The big door has gotten a small content update, so now you can experiment with some escape pods!
🚽Toilet Room: No matter if your bowel needs some relief from all this gravity-shifting  or you're in need of some water for your shenanigans, the toilet room is the right place for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/e614de57c92d60f96eb9cedab80c00706cc66c5b.jpg[/img]

⭐[b]REWORKED OLD STUFF![/b]
Old spaces got an architectural makeover and existing spaces have been altered and adjusted based on player feedback. There's now new things to unlock (including Steam achievements) and additional riddling involved, to get your brains going! Also: Some items might have gotten some new features, so keep an open eye! Some of them could possibly fit somewhere they didn't belong previously... 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/51f726bd1e168fb0aaacd58c06e991ba9e44c262.jpg[/img]

⭐[b]NEW ITEMS, MACHINES and a MAP![/b]
New items: A space rocket, a space thruster, plants that do weird things? We've got you covered!
New machines: An item cannon and escape pods to keep you entertained!
New map: In addition to the regular map in the launch room, you can now enter a larger map and a timeline by scrolling down on your mouse wheel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/b8b4acc833914469947bb56850f0480306c79a7e.jpg[/img]

⭐[b]NEW VISUALS![/b]
New look for the main menu, memory menu, codepad, ... and for the gravity generators!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/4a6c683c9eb36818335b8f997fb3bb0804f0c197.png[/img]

While we were focusing on adding more exciting gadgets, mechanics and rooms to our new demo, we are also simultaneously finishing up the spaceship with lots of content, secrets and mechanics you will be able to play in the full version!
